summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle at install time
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs` in package.json) downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/... and uses it to execute a shipped 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle `math_init.js` on the installer's machine via `execFileSync`. The bundle is a Bun-compiled CJS module (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) using string-array rotation and mangled identifiers, so its behavior is not inspectable prior to execution. Fetching a secondary runtime specifically to execute an opaque sibling file at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern. The package.json also has empty `author`, empty `description`, and no `repository` field despite publishing under the `@servicetitan` scope, consistent with scope impersonation of an internal ServiceTitan namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
